labels.description: Adds a new exposure from the current or future listing of Recorded Future as an "undesirable" or "unreliable" entity by certain jurisdictions, and moves AI-enabled threats from hypothetical ("may be further enhanced") to realized ("is enhancing"), with fraud and cyber-attacks now "further exacerbated" by AI.
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 2: a new exposure tied to the named Recorded Future business and jurisdictional designations is disclosed, and criterion 3 applies to the could-to-is shift on AI threats; the cross-reference rename is minor but does not offset these.

labels.description: Adds network degradation, updates and migrations to new technology and platforms, and cybersecurity-related disruptions or failures of service providers as new sources of service interruption.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: new operational risk sources are disclosed, widening the scope of the disruption risk (criterion 3).

labels.description: Risk factor text is identical; the only difference is a page header/footer artifact inserted at the section boundary.
labels.rationale: minor: no substantive change, only pagination text.

labels.description: The reference point for bank failures that could drive consolidation changes from those "that occurred in the U.S. in recent years" to those "that occurred in recent years", dropping the U.S. qualifier.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a jurisdiction reference (the U.S.) is dropped, which also widens the geographic scope of the example (criterion 3).

labels.description: Replaces the statement that, outside the U.S. and a select number of other jurisdictions, most in-country transactions are switched by customers or other processors with a statement that Mastercard switches a high percentage of domestic transactions and only several jurisdictions rely on customers or other processors.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the scope of the dependency on customers to manage the brand in domestic switching is narrowed and recharacterized, and the U.S. reference is dropped (criterion 2).

labels.description: Risk factor text is identical; the only difference is a page header/footer artifact inserted mid-section.
labels.rationale: minor: no substantive change, only pagination text.

labels.description: Adds system integrators and other third party partners as intermediaries through which Mastercard works and contracts with governments, alongside financial institutions, in both the scope statement and the reputational risk bullet.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a new category of counterparty is referenced, widening the scope of government-related exposure (criterion 3); the parenthetical and paragraph-merge edits are stylistic.
